Strings.permission.server.files.read.description: Read files, directory structure, and basic metadata on the server.
Strings.permission.server.files.write.descriptio: Create, upload, edit, rename, and delete server files. This does not include changing file ownership or system permissions.
Strings.permission.server.processes.manage.descr: View, start, stop, or terminate server processes. This permission includes reading the process list.
Strings.permission.server.services.manage.descri: View, start, stop, or restart services on the server.
Strings.permission.server.network.read.descripti: Read network interfaces, IP addresses, routes, and connection state.
Strings.permission.server.network.configure.desc: Change server IP addresses, routes, DNS, and other network configuration. It does not grant unrelated management capabilities.
Strings.permission.server.power.manage.descripti: Request high-impact server operations such as restart or shutdown.
Strings.permission.desktop.wallpaper.write.descr: Allow this application to change the current workspace wallpaper through RemoteOS.
Strings.permission.server.metrics.read.descripti: Read aggregate CPU, memory, disk, network, and GPU metrics from the server.
Strings.permission.diagnostics.network.read.desc: Read redacted RemoteOS API summaries for this client session. Tokens, cookies, payloads, and arbitrary network traffic are never exposed.
